sources_used.title: Predictive coding in the visual cortex: a functional interpretation of some extra-classical receptive-field effects
sources_used.notes: Foundational paper. Subscription journal, no PMC. Abstract only.

sources_used.title: Predictive coding under the free-energy principle
sources_used.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B
sources_used.notes: PMC2666703. Full text read. Core computational framework: variational free energy, generalised coordinates, birdsong simulations, state/error units.

sources_used.title: The free-energy principle: a unified brain theory?
sources_used.notes: Unified theory review. Nature Reviews subscription. Abstract only.

sources_used.title: Canonical microcircuits for predictive coding
sources_used.notes: PMC available but blocked by CAPTCHA. Used abstract level. L2/3 error units gamma, L5/6 prediction units alpha/beta.

sources_used.title: Whatever next? Predictive brains, situated agents, and the future of cognitive science
sources_used.notes: Philosophical synthesis. Abstract only. Key contribution: active inference and situated agency.

sources_used.title: Frontal cortex function as derived from hierarchical predictive coding
sources_used.notes: PMC5832795. Full text read. HER model: dlPFC learns to predict prediction errors. 7 experimental paradigms simulated. Mixed selectivity emergent from error prediction.

sources_used.title: Predictive Processing: A Canonical Cortical Computation
sources_used.notes: PMC available but blocked. Abstract used. Sensorimotor mismatch experiment (VR + V1 L2/3 imaging). 10 experimental predictions listed.

sources_used.title: Dynamic predictive coding: A model of hierarchical sequence learning and prediction in the neocortex
sources_used.notes: Open access PLoS. Dynamic extension of Rao-Ballard to temporal sequences. Natural video training → V1-like spatiotemporal RFs. Predictive/postdictive effects. Episodic memory retrieval.

coverage_summary.quality_assessment: Good coverage of foundational (Rao-Ballard 1999), mathematical (Friston 2009/2010), circuit (Bastos 2012), philosophical (Clark 2013), experimental (Keller 2018), and recent computational (Jiang & Rao 2024) literature
